method.sample: newest 400 Shorts from /shorts tab (yt-dlp --flat-playlist on Spark); views rounded to 2 sig figs by YouTube; full per-video metadata (date, duration, likes, comments) for 183 of them before YouTube bot-wall stopped yt-dlp; remaining dates interpolated from upload order at 4.87/day
method.outlier: views / median views of the 31 neighbouring uploads (centered, by upload order); videos uploaded after 2026-10-29 (<3 days old at fetch) excluded from stats and picks
method.clusters: hand-checked keyword clustering of titles (primary topic only)
method.platforms_other: TikTok: yt-dlp on @zackdfilms returns a different 2-video account ("zoomy", ~500 views); @zack.d.films returned nothing. Instagram needs login; skipped. YouTube only.
method.blocked: After 183 per-video fetches YouTube returned "Sign in to confirm you are not a bot" to the Spark IP (still blocked at end of run). Not bypassed. Durations/likes/exact dates missing for the older ~217.
